generationTemplates.overview: Template bank for generating reusable IELTS band test items across 10 test sets, 6 skills, and all official half-band levels from 1.0 to 9.0.
usageNotes: Use setTemplates to choose a thematic pack before generation.
Use skillBandTemplates to control difficulty, prompt style, and distractor quality.
When generating a full band test, mix 45 percent core, 30 percent review, and 25 percent challenge items unless the runtime overrides the ratio.
Always randomise topics, numbers, names, and surface wording so the same template can be reused many times.
Keep explanations short enough for storage but specific enough for remediation tags.

setTemplates.title: Campus and Study

skillTargets.reading: rotate passage genre among notice, article, report, opinion, data summary
skillTargets.listening: rotate script genre among conversation, announcement, lecture, consultation
skillTargets.grammar: rotate focus among tense, clause, agreement, reference, inversion, conditionals
skillTargets.vocabulary: rotate synonym, collocation, academic word, word form, paraphrase trap
skillTargets.writing: rotate task1 and task2 prompts with different data and viewpoints
skillTargets.speaking: rotate part 1, part 2, part 3 themes while preserving target band behaviours

aiGenerationGuardrails: Do not repeat the same stem inside one test run
Keep question type balance aligned with the selected skill
Use fresh named entities, places, numbers, and scenarios each generation
Keep distractors plausible but separable by the target band
When mixing bands, preserve the target skill profile rather than only changing topic words
